answer_1.quote: The system policy π decides the system action a S according to the system dialog state s S to give the appropriate response to user agent. Each system action a S is a subset of dialog act set A as there may be multiple intents in one dialog turn.

answer_2.quote: We utilize two other metrics: inform F1 and match rate to estimate the task success. Both metrics are calculated at the dialog act level.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we hire Amazon Mechanical Turkers to conduct pairwise comparison between MADPL and baselines.
answer_4.guideline: Each Turker is asked to read a user goal first, then we show 2 dialog sessions around this user goal, one from MADPL and the other from another baseline. ... For each goal, 5 Turkers are asked to judge which dialog is better (win, draw or lose) according to different subjective assessments independently: (I) system quality, (II) user quality, and (III) task success.
